tasks.title: Fix Session Event Tracking
tasks.description: Update SessionEngineService to persist nudge and unlock counts to the Session entity
tasks.details: Modify triggerNudge() to increment totalReminders in Session entity. Modify onScreenUnlocked() to increment totalUnlocks in Session entity. This ensures session summaries show accurate counts.
tasks.testStrategy: Test nudge triggering updates database. Test screen unlock tracking updates database. Verify SessionSummaryScreen displays correct counts.

tasks.title: Implement Snooze and Extend Logic
tasks.description: Complete ReminderViewModel snooze() and extend() methods to properly handle nudge delays and session extensions
tasks.details: Implement snooze() to communicate with SessionEngineService to delay next nudge. Implement extend() to add 5 minutes to current session duration. Add necessary SessionController methods.
tasks.testStrategy: Test snooze delays next nudge by configured interval. Test extend adds 5 minutes to session. Verify both track events in SessionEvent table.

tasks.title: Implement Boot Recovery Logic
tasks.description: Complete onBootCompleted() in SessionEngineService to recover active sessions after device reboot
tasks.details: Check for sessions with RUNNING or PAUSED status on boot. Calculate remaining time and restart session if time remains. Mark as COMPLETED if time has expired.
tasks.testStrategy: Start session, reboot device, verify session continues. Start session near end, reboot, verify session completes properly.

tasks.title: Implement Daily/Weekly Session Statistics
tasks.description: Add session aggregation functionality to show daily, weekly, and monthly statistics with a beautiful stats screen
tasks.details:
1. Add aggregation methods to SessionRepository (getDailyStats, getWeeklyStats, getMonthlyStats)
2. Create SessionStats data class with calculated properties
3. Create StatsScreen.kt with card-based UI showing today, week, and month stats
4. Create StatsViewModel.kt to manage statistics state
5. Add stats route to navigation in MainActivity
6. Optional: Add quick stats widget to Dashboard
tasks.testStrategy: Verify stats calculate correctly. Test with multiple completed sessions. Verify UI displays stats properly. Test date range calculations for daily/weekly/monthly.
